summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics, not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data; current public terms restrict relevant collection and derivative use. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, external request, affiliate use, or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts show progress but do not satisfy task deliverables. Close no task. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; missing written rights, field-level provenance and use limits, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert permissions, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate/advertising terms. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next actions: complete the internal rights counsel packet for human-counsel review; produce the read-only data-flow/retention table; capture consent and GA4 configuration without enabling new tracking; and produce the read-only log/vendor/incident/request inventory.

Fleet legal/compliance evidence is a technical baseline, not certification: 36 sites pass, 17 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include banner, consent accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; do not treat unavailable telemetry as zero. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon results of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, which is not site-attributable. No site-level revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal-lift claim is supported.

Legal launch decision for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net: keep each parked, private, and preview-only. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker; reconsider only after the packet and technical, security, measurement, and legal gates are evidenced.
